name: graphed-executors
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.0.4"

package:
  name: graphed-executors
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/g/graphed-executors/graphed_executors-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8d758bfe94a2e96735ea6770c5065ee41efdb92aec9558d23cc1e4b277e68020

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - hatchling
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - graphed >=0.0.2
  # The dask and parsl backends are optional (pyproject extras `dask`/`parsl`); the local
  # thread/process executors need neither. Constrain rather than require so an environment that
  # installs them gets a version the backends were written against.
  run_constraints:
    - dask >=2026.6
    - distributed >=2026.6
    - parsl >=2026.7.20

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - graphed_executors
        - graphed_executors.local
        - graphed_exec_local
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - python -c "from graphed_executors.local.executors import ExecContext, LocalResources; print(ExecContext, LocalResources)"

about:
  summary: Run a graphed plan on threads, processes, a dask cluster, or a parsl pool
  description: |
    Executors for graphed plans. The local backend (threads and pinned process pools, peer
    reduction, work stealing) has no extra dependencies; the dask.distributed and parsl
    backends are activated by installing `dask`/`distributed` or `parsl` alongside this
    package.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/graphed-org/graphed-executors
  repository: https://github.com/graphed-org/graphed-executors
  documentation: https://graphed-executors.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - lgray
